description: [1/4] AIKit integration: attach project, seed .aikit memory, ledger plan and ADRs

impact_assessment.why: Postbox was created as an unattached scratch project; the user asked to make it AIKit-compatible and properly production-quality.
impact_assessment.benefits: Own git repo plus .aikit memory, gated delivery, explicit decisions, and a cold-start path for future work.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: persisted JSONL format must stay readable and versioned; dependency: stdlib only, no new packages; concurrency: threaded server appends must not interleave; state: append/clear atomicity and retention bounds must not lose captured requests.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a format version with refuse-on-unknown and a migration hook; lock every write; fsync each append; atomic os.replace for clear; failing-first tests per behaviour; run project check before any commit.
